description: This file contains functions and constants for creating challenge pages and super block intro pages in a Gatsby-based React project, including template component selection and project preview configuration.

methods.name: getIsFirstStepInBlock
methods.description: Determines if the current challenge is the first in its block based on its index and nodes array.

methods.name: getTemplateComponent
methods.description: Returns the template component based on the challenge type.

methods.name: createChallengePages
methods.description: Creates challenge pages with appropriate context and template based on challenge data.

methods.name: getProjectPreviewConfig
methods.description: Generates project preview configuration for the last challenge in a block, including challenge files and contents.

methods.name: createSuperBlockIntroPages
methods.description: Creates super block introduction pages with certification, superBlock, and title context.
